O.outcome_detail: share of participants from low-GNI countries

cells.quote: Between 2005 and 2011, the IAYC saw proportionally more participants from low GNI countries compared to recent years. The last time the camp was hosted in a low GNI country was in 2011, and the proportion of participants from these countries has been on a downward trend since 2007. In 2019, the camp fee was raised to 850 EUR after it remained at 690 EUR (not inﬂation adjusted) for the preceding five years.
cells.note: The study reports fee and participation trends descriptively and does not estimate an independent causal effect of camp fee.
